explanations.label: First stock-out day

explanations.label: Cash at the end of the horizon
explanations.sentence: Cash ends the 30-day horizon at ₹-47,600.

explanations.label: Failed supplier payments
explanations.sentence: 2 supplier payments fail: the ₹2,75,000 payment to Supplier A on day 23; the ₹70,000 payment to Supplier C on day 25.

explanations.label: Order delay

explanations.label: Customer payment day
explanations.sentence: The customer pays on day 29.

assumptions.text: The supplier invoice date does not move when delivery is late, so the Supplier A invoice stays due on day 23.
